title: Mirabel and the Orchard
author: Rafael Joubert
blurb: Yara Okafor, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
